name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees very softly bent, and hands resting lightly on your hips to feel your pelvic motion.
Gently tuck your tailbone under by tightening your abs and glutes to flatten your lower back.
Slowly reverse the motion by tipping your pelvis forward to create a mild, comfortable arch in your lower back.
Continue gliding smoothly between tucked and arched pelvic positions for the target duration.
tips: Keep your rib cage and upper torso calm so the movement comes cleanly from your pelvis and lower spine.
Move slowly within a comfortable range without forcing painful lumbar arches.
